race.comment: ODIN'S MOUNT (20) made the perfect return at Warwick when scoring comfortably and has since followed it up with two narrow defeats. The form around him is red-hot and KWT draws to have him blending in at the right time. Looks the one to beat. IMPACT ZONE (7) was decisive as favourite at Ipswich, and beat CUESTA there two back. Rock-hard fit now and should give a bold sight from the favourable draw. CUESTA (9) brings winning form after justifying her short quote at the Sunny Coast, and her 1400m record gives the form real substance despite a stiffer task. COBRA CLUB (2) has been freshened with 58 days after an uncharacteristically bad performance at Warwick Farm. Is drawn to advantage and gets an important claim. If he's back to his best he can take care of these, but it's a big IF.
